note: Manufacturing rules and cost inputs (H1). Every rate and price is a stated input, not a quote: replace them with your own printer, shop and supplier numbers. Currency USD. Rules marked 'assumption' are typical values chosen for the demo.

PETG.source: assumption: typical retail PETG filament, 1 kg spools (20-30 USD)

PLA.source: assumption: typical retail PLA filament, 1 kg spools (15-25 USD)

AL6061T6.source: assumption: 6061-T6 plate or bar stock, small quantities (5-15 USD/kg)

S235.source: assumption: structural steel plate, small quantities

layer_mm.source: common layer height for a 0.4 mm nozzle

min_wall_nozzles.source: rule of thumb: a wall needs at least two extrusion widths

min_hole_mm.source: assumption: smaller vertical holes close up and are drilled after printing

max_overhang_deg.source: common support-free overhang limit, measured from vertical

build_volume_mm.source: assumption: typical desktop printer (e.g. 250 x 210 x 220 mm class)

volumetric_rate_mm3_s.source: assumption: average deposition rate over a whole PETG print including travel and slower perimeters (hot ends peak at 10-20 mm^3/s)

support_fill.source: assumption: support printed at about 15% density

machine_rate_per_h.source: assumption: electricity, wear and depreciation of a desktop printer

setup_min.source: assumption: slicing, bed preparation and part removal

approach_directions.source: assumption: 3-axis milling in two setups, from the top and flipped

tool_radius_mm.source: assumption: 6 mm flat end mill for pockets and internal corners

max_depth_to_width.source: rule of thumb: pocket depth up to about 4x the tool diameter

material_removal_rate_mm3_s.source: assumption: average over roughing and finishing in aluminium on a small vertical mill

machine_rate_per_h.source: assumption: small job-shop hourly rate (typically 40-120 USD/h)

setup_min.source: assumption: per setup (fixturing, zeroing, first-article check)
